items.title: Pharma Q2 Outlook: Pricing pressure, US competition to weigh on select players
items.description: India's pharmaceutical companies are expected to have a mixed performance in the upcoming September quarter. Companies like Sun Pharmaceutical Industries and Aurobindo Pharma are likely to report good growth. In contrast, Dr Reddy's Laboratories and Lupin may face challenges due to increased competition and a high base. Pricing pressure and elevated raw material costs are also expected to impact overall performance.

items.title: UltraTech Cement Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 21% YoY to Rs 1,494 crore; revenue up 19%
items.description: UltraTech Cement Q2 Results: The cement maker reported a 21% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,494 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue grew 19% to Rs 23,295 crore. However, profit fell 43% sequentially amid monsoon-related disruptions and the West Asia crisis, with margins also declining from the previous quarter.

items.title: HFCL Q2 Results: Profit zooms 448% YoY to Rs 394 crore; stock hits 5% upper circuit
items.description: HFCL reported a 448% year-on-year jump in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 394 crore, compared with Rs 71.92 crore a year ago. Revenue surged 144% to Rs 2,542 crore, while EBITDA rose 224% to Rs 658 crore. EBITDA margin expanded 640 basis points to 25.89%. The optical fibre and AI beneficiary’s stock hit the 5% upper circuit at Rs 268.70 on the BSE and has gained nearly 300% so far this year.

items.title: Ireda net profit grows to Rs 554 cr in Sep qtr
items.description: Ireda has announced a net profit of Rs 554 crore for the September quarter of FY27, reflecting a robust financial performance. Revenue from operations increased by 14%, totaling Rs 2,345 crore. Additionally, loan disbursements surged by 31%, reaching Rs 10,579 crore. This quarter also marked an 11% rise in net worth, showcasing Ireda's strength in renewable energy financing and management of asset quality.

items.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 consolidated net profit rises 29% to Rs 6,367 crore
items.description: Bajaj Finance expects AUM to grow 26-27% in FY27 as it accelerates customer acquisition and loan disbursements. The lender plans to book 60-62 million new loans and add 18-20 million customers during the year. Consolidated AUM grew 26% to Rs 5.85 lakh crore in the September quarter, aided by broad-based loan growth. The gold-loan portfolio more than doubled to Rs 24,195 crore, although short-tenor schemes caused a transitional increase in Stage 2 assets. Management does not expect this movement to affect credit costs. Lower funding costs, improving asset quality and a strong liquidity buffer should support growth.

items.title: Waaree Renewable Technologies Q2 Results: Net profit falls 29% to Rs 81 crore
items.description: Waaree Renewable Technologies experienced a notable 29 percent drop in net profit for the quarter ending September. Their consolidated profit stood at Rs 81.48 crore, a decrease from Rs 116.36 crore year-on-year. While expenses surged, revenues rose to Rs 1,057.84 crore. The company boasts an unexecuted order book over Rs 5,500 crore and a robust bidding pipeline, striving for long-term value through efficiencies and scaling.

items.title: Piramal Finance Q2 net profit soars 67% to Rs 545 crore
items.description: Piramal Finance’s assets under management grew 24% to Rs 1.13 lakh crore, led by a 30% rise in retail AUM. Net interest income increased 35%, while its net interest margin expanded 35 basis points to 6.5%.

items.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 29% YoY to Rs 6,367 crore, NII up 24%
items.description: Bajaj Finance Q2 Results: Bajaj Finance reported a 29% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 6,367 crore in the September quarter, compared with Rs 4,948 crore a year earlier. Net interest income rose 24% to Rs 13,335 crore from Rs 10,785 crore in the year-ago quarter. Net total income increased 23% to Rs 15,974 crore from Rs 12,982 crore.

items.title: Hindustan Zinc Q2 Results: Net profit skyrockets 142% YoY to Rs 6,412 crore, revenue soars 77%
items.description: Hindustan Zinc reported a 142% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 6,412 crore, while revenue surged 76.5% to Rs 15,093 crore. EBITDA doubled to Rs 9,285 crore, with margins expanding to 62% on higher prices and production.
